notes.title: "Where's Mommy?" update is now live!
notes.content:
Good day, our dear and wonderful player community.

Patch note:

1. Introducing a new gameplay chapter “Where’s Mommy”.
Play as the Celestial Child, dive into the experience and find out the reasons why the child is looking for her mom.(Unlock: Complete the story mode.)

2. Optimizing the exploration experience and environment of Chapter 5.

3. Introducing new censoring mode: In game setting, players can choose to censor nudity.

4. Gameplay optimization and bug fixing.

notes.title: Face THE Mother and get surrounded by the chanting on Nov 18.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We're excited to announce that Incantation [b]will be released on Steam on November 18th, 2024[/b]. 
 
"Incantation" is a first-person horror game filled with mysteries adapted from a movie of the same name. The game reveals the chilling story behind "Chen Village" from the movie. A mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a village filled with mysterious rituals. Beyond the village's palpable madness and fear, a sinister force drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line connected to this evil deity?

notes.title: Incantation - Official Steam Next Fest trailer
notes.content:
Developed by Softstar Entertainment Inc., the horror game adaptation of the classic horror movie “Incantation” has released the official Steam Next Fest announcement trailer and the demo on Steam today. Players can now take a peek at the Chen village surrounded by a treacherous vibe.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772093/478244953eb8f2cb8b8ea48d88b386785bb7db57.jpg[/img]

“Incantation” is a horror game adaptation of the classic Taiwan horror movie which shares the same name. The extended independent story of the game is based on the background of the well-known Chen village in the movie, describing a mother who’s looking for her missing child, and accidentally stumbled into a remote mountain village devoted to a mysterious religion. Following her trespassing, the unknown secrets of that mysterious village have been gradually unveiled. Players will play as the mother and explore the uncanny village in first person while a strange force is closing in step by step. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772093/6656c08d2b46cc25eb01de871839a34b3ae572e4.jpg[/img]

The story of the trailer begins with a strange car accident, players will start the mission in first person, intruding on the gloomy Chen village in panic and facing all kinds of paranormal activities, including a village without any villagers, unspeakable rituals, and a late-night cemetery without an exit. The weird background music plus realistic ambiance will lead players during exploration and discover the truth behind the mysterious religion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772093/a0a9028a78f04d44baedb8b2b9e32d18bc049d43.jpg[/img]

Besides releasing the Steam Next Fest demo and the first official trailer, the development team also prepared a time-limited giveaway campaign, simply add “Incantation” to your Steam Wishlist to join. All horror game lovers are welcome to follow the official Incantation social media and Steam page, become a cult member early, and receive first-hand information! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772093/2e4a1ec48702f01d3ff5a8e653c1b99cb93c7450.jpg[/img]
